title: Publish standard dairy supply terms and minimum prices (processors)
what: A dairy processor that intends to buy milk in the next financial year must publish its standard form supply agreements, with their minimum prices, by the 1 June deadline.

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Dairy) Regulations 2019
sources.quote: 12 Requirement to publish standard forms of agreements each 1 June Publication deadline (1) This section applies in relation to a corporation that, at 2 pm (by legal time in the Australian Capital Territory) on 1 June in a financial year (the publication deadline): (a) is a processor; and (b) intends to purchase milk during the next financial year. Requirement to publish standard forms of agreements (2) The processor must, at or before the publication deadline, publish on its website in accordance with subsections (3) to (5): (a) one or more standard forms of milk supply agreements; and (b) for each standard form the processor publishes under paragraph (a)—a statement of the circumstances in which the processor would enter into a milk supply agreement in that form.

reach.condition: if it is a dairy processor that buys milk from farmers
